condition: approved local record exists
output_ipa_or_action: use reviewed IPA and supplied stress
validation_question: Who approved the record and for which speaker/task?

condition: token exists in CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
output_ipa_or_action: convert ARPAbet to IPA and retain dictionary stress
example: topic -> t ɑ p ɪ k; model -> m ɑ d ə l
validation_question: Does this English source match a local label-reading task?

condition: batch: CMUdict misses; browser query: bundled engine is available
output_ipa_or_action: run en-us dictionary plus context-sensitive pronunciation rules and convert the IPA to lattice phones
example: binary -> b aɪ n ɚ i; cefuroxime -> s ɛ f j ʊ r ɑ k s aɪ m
coverage_action: mark unavailable if the provider fails
validation_question: Does this English seed match the intended medicine and reading context?

condition: CMUdict and eSpeak NG miss and Flite lex_lookup is on PATH
output_ipa_or_action: use Epitran eng-Latn trans_list IPA
validation_question: How often do Cebuano reviewers accept this English seed?

condition: emergency only: CMUdict misses and eSpeak NG plus Epitran English are unavailable or return no usable path
output_ipa_or_action: documented fallback respelling then IPA-like tokens
validation_question: Should this fallback be replaced by a real G2P source or speaker data?

condition: ceb-Latn maps every input unit
output_ipa_or_action: use Epitran Cebuano direct-reading IPA
example: topic -> t o p i k
validation_question: Does direct spelling reading occur for this medicine name?

condition: browser contextual G2P is being shown in parallel
output_ipa_or_action: apply the documented Cebuano-compatible consonant spelling rules and final-y context as a separate recovery display
coverage_action: never label as English source IPA
validation_question: Does this direct-spelling recovery match how local readers handle an unfamiliar label?

condition: all English vowel nuclei reconcile monotonically after costed silent-anchor and split-cluster decisions
output_ipa_or_action: emit exactly one deterministic aligned local reading even when its display matches the English source
example: ball -> bol; omeprazole keeps one route despite silent written vowels
coverage_action: record skipped anchors and aligned nuclei
validation_question: Does the silence-aware monotonic alignment match reviewer judgments?

condition: complete written-vowel alignment cannot be formed
output_ipa_or_action: preserve unmatched English phones and apply only safely aligned context decisions in one visibly partial route
example: rhythm retains a conservative partial local route
coverage_action: never present partial alignment as complete
validation_question: Does the partial route help review without implying unsupported letter-to-phone links?

input_domain: browser free-text vowel anchor written as standalone a or ar
condition: aligned English display differs from the context-selected a/o/ey value
output_ipa_or_action: choose the contextual local a/o/ey output; restore r only when bundled in an aligned rhotic nucleus
source: Project rule informed by index-preserving and many-to-many G2P alignment research
coverage_action: fail closed when vowel anchors are ambiguous
validation_question: Do local readers accept this aligned written-a result for the label-reading task?

condition: aligned English nucleus does not display e
output_ipa_or_action: realize the standalone local vowel as e
validation_question: Do local readers use e in this written context?

condition: aligned English nucleus does not display o
output_ipa_or_action: realize the standalone local vowel as monophthong o
example: topic -> topik; model -> model; note -> not
validation_question: Do local readers monophthongize written o in this context?

condition: aligned English display is not i, e, or ay
output_ipa_or_action: realize the local vowel as i
validation_question: Which i/e/ay contexts are supported by speaker data?

input_domain: browser free-text standalone written u or initial ur
condition: aligned source conflicts with the contextual a/o/u value
output_ipa_or_action: realize initial ur or a final closed-syllable u with contextual o and otherwise retain an allowed a/o/u value
validation_question: Which written-u contexts are supported by local label readings?

input_domain: browser free-text adjacent written vowels split across two aligned nuclei
condition: second aligned anchor is a after a front vowel
output_ipa_or_action: insert a y glide before the second local vowel
coverage_action: apply only inside a split aligned vowel cluster
validation_question: Do local readers insert a glide in this hiatus context?

input_domain: normalized spelling after explicit compatibility substitutions
condition: at least one listed compatibility rule fires and repaired ceb-Latn coverage is complete
output_ipa_or_action: use Epitran Cebuano on the explicitly repaired spelling
validation_question: Does the complete repaired route match a locally validated label reading?

condition: raw coverage fails because of x
output_ipa_or_action: replace x with ks before a second coverage check
validation_question: Is this repair plausible for the relevant local task?

condition: normalized token ends in y
output_ipa_or_action: replace only final y with i before the nativized Epitran coverage check
validation_question: Do local readers realize final y as /i/ in this medicine name?

condition: English-derived path contains /f/ or compatibility repair sees written f
output_ipa_or_action: produce a bounded /p/ alternative or f->p compatibility repair
source: Wolff inventory motivation plus validation required
validation_question: How often do reviewers use /p/ rather than /f/?

condition: English-derived path contains /v/ or compatibility repair sees written v
output_ipa_or_action: produce a bounded /b/ alternative or v->b compatibility repair
source: Wolff inventory motivation plus validation required
validation_question: How often do reviewers use /b/ rather than /v/?

condition: English-derived path contains /z/ or compatibility repair sees written z
output_ipa_or_action: produce a bounded /s/ alternative or z->s compatibility repair
source: Wolff inventory motivation plus validation required
validation_question: How often do reviewers use /s/ rather than /z/?

condition: raw coverage fails because of q
output_ipa_or_action: replace q with k before a second coverage check
validation_question: Is this spelling repair accepted by reviewers?

condition: English-derived path contains /θ/
output_ipa_or_action: add bounded /t/ alternative
validation_question: Does the adapted phone improve reviewer agreement?

condition: English-derived path contains /ð/
output_ipa_or_action: add bounded /d/ alternative
validation_question: Does the adapted phone improve reviewer agreement?

condition: English-derived path contains /r/
output_ipa_or_action: add bounded /ɾ/ alternative
validation_question: Does the adapted phone improve reviewer agreement?

condition: English-derived path has /ɪ ɛ e/
output_ipa_or_action: add bounded i/e-like alternatives
source: Wolff vowel notation motivation plus validation required
validation_question: Which vowel distinctions matter in the recorded task?

condition: English-derived path has /u ʊ ɔ o oʊ/
output_ipa_or_action: add bounded u/o-like alternatives
source: Wolff vowel notation motivation plus validation required
validation_question: Which vowel distinctions matter in the recorded task?

condition: English-derived path contains /ə/
output_ipa_or_action: add separately costed /a/ or /e/ phone hypotheses without treating either as a written-letter rewrite
source: Project phone-adaptation hypothesis requiring speaker validation
validation_question: Does this phone hypothesis agree with the source grapheme and recorded local reading?

condition: initial s plus consonant is present
output_ipa_or_action: add e- or i-support-vowel display hypothesis
validation_question: Do speakers add a support vowel in this task?

condition: final consonant plus le/les is present
output_ipa_or_action: add a vocalized final-syllable display hypothesis
validation_question: Do speakers use a vocalized final syllable?

condition: comparison baseline only
output_ipa_or_action: produce documented older Cebuano-friendly respelling
validation_question: Does the weighted lattice outperform this baseline?

condition: legacy batch comparison baseline only; never a browser or default pronunciation
output_ipa_or_action: produce the older e/i and o/u merged respelling
coverage_action: exclude from browser free-text and default pronunciation
validation_question: Does this legacy batch path increase recall at an acceptable review burden?

condition: token contains digits
output_ipa_or_action: retain a distinct numeric segment
validation_question: Does the review workflow preserve strength/version distinctions?

condition: all candidate path pairs
output_ipa_or_action: select maximum raw similarity after subtracting both route costs
validation_question: Which costs best match reviewer judgments?
